_comment: Example of the release_note_drafter section of config.json. Setup (SKILL.md) and the voice lookup (references/voice.md) write it after the user confirms. Every value is a placeholder and yours to replace. null voice = the skill's built-in style. Don't commit a real config to a shared repo.

page._comment: status_labels maps the standard's open beta and GA to your page's own tag names. Closed beta still never publishes.

glossary._comment: Values for the terminology traps in references/release-note-standards.md. banned_phrases are added to the mechanical check's list. allowed_names are verified product or feature names that contain "&" or a banned word; the check skips them.
hierarchy_terms: <word that names a level in your product, for example workspace>
banned_phrases: <phrase that belongs in marketing, not release notes>
allowed_names: <verified name that contains & or a banned word, exact spelling>
style_files: <title or link of your style guide or glossary>

voice._comment: source: config, skill, memory, instructions, or pasted. source_skill names an installed voice or style skill (a pointer, never its content); source_refs lists memory or instruction files or doc titles. The voice sets tone and word choice only; the skill's hard rules always win.
voice.summary: <two to four lines: how your brand sounds>
set_aside: <voice rule the hard rules override, for example: em dashes>
